name: Microwave Steamed Broccoli and Tofu
ingredients: Dressing: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 garlic clove (grated), 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp oil
steps: Place the broccoli in a microwave-safe bowl with 2 tbsp water, cover with a plate and microwave on high for 3 minutes.
Add the tofu on top, cover and microwave for 2 minutes more.
Drain any liquid and toss the broccoli and tofu with the dressing.
Top with chilli flakes, spring onion and lime juice.
note: About 21 g protein and only 10 g carbohydrate; steam, do not boil, to retain nutrients.
